int compare_text(string first, string second)
    int[] left_codes := first.codepoints()
    int[] right_codes := second.codepoints()
    count := if #left_codes < #right_codes then #left_codes else #right_codes
    for: i < count
        if left_codes[i] != right_codes[i]
            return if left_codes[i] < right_codes[i] then -1 else 1
    return if #left_codes < #right_codes then -1 elif #left_codes > #right_codes then 1 else 0

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool has<T>(T[] items, T item)
    for value := items[]
        if value == item
            return true
    return false

int index(string[] items, string item)
    for: i < #items
        if items[i] == item
            return int(i)
    return -1

bool name_ok(string word, upper := false)
    letters := if upper then "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" else "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    if #word == 0 or #word > 16 or not letters.contains(word[0])
        return false
    for: i < #word
        if not (letters + "0123456789_").contains(word[i])
            return false
    return true

bool number_ok(string word)
    if #word == 0 or #word > 9 or (#word > 1 and word[0] == "0")
        return false
    for: i < #word
        if not "0123456789".contains(word[i])
            return false
    return true

int | error number(string word, positive := false)
    if not number_ok(word)
        return error("bad number " + word)
    value := int(word)
    if positive and value == 0
        return error("bad number " + word)
    return value

string | error value_word(string word)
    if not has(["0", "1", "X"], word)
        return error("bad value " + word)
    return word

string bits(int row, nat width)
    result := ""
    remaining := row
    for: i < width
        result = string(remaining % 2) + result
        remaining /= 2
    return result

string gate_value(string kind, string[] values)
    result := values[0]
    if kind == "AND" or kind == "NAND"
        result = if has(values, "0") then "0" elif has(values, "X") then "X" else "1"
    elif kind == "OR" or kind == "NOR"
        result = if has(values, "1") then "1" elif has(values, "X") then "X" else "0"
    elif kind == "XOR" or kind == "XNOR"
        count := 0
        for item := values[]
            if item == "1"
                count += 1
        result = if has(values, "X") then "X" else string(count % 2)
    elif kind == "MUX2"
        result = if values[0] == "0" then values[1] elif values[0] == "1" then values[2] elif values[1] == values[2] then values[1] else "X"
    if has(["NAND", "NOR", "XNOR", "NOT"], kind)
        result = if result == "0" then "1" elif result == "1" then "0" else "X"
    return result

class Gate(string label, string kind, string[] inputs, string output, int delay)
class Instance(string label, int module_id, string[] ports, string[] signals)
class Module(string label, string[] inputs, string[] outputs, Gate[] gates, Instance[] instances, int[] order)
class Event(int timestamp, int signal_id, string value)
class Change(int timestamp, string value)

class Circuit(label := "", string[] inputs := [], string[] outputs := [], Gate[] gates := [])
    string[] signals := inputs.concat([for gate := gates[] then gate.output])
    int[] topological := []
    looped := false

    void .initialize()
        ready := inputs
        remaining := 0
        for gate := gates[]
            if gate.kind == "DFF"
                ready = ready.append(gate.output)
            else
                remaining += 1
        while remaining > 0
            changed := false
            for: i < #gates
                gate := gates[i]
                if gate.kind == "DFF" or has(topological, int(i))
                    continue
                available := true
                for source := gate.inputs[]
                    if not has(ready, source)
                        available = false
                if available
                    topological = topological.append(int(i))
                    ready = ready.append(gate.output)
                    remaining -= 1
                    changed = true
            if not changed
                looped = true
                break

    int[] readers(string signal)
        return [for i := (nat(0):<#gates)[] if has(gates[i].inputs, signal) then int(i)]

    void | error combinational()
        for gate := gates[]
            if gate.kind == "DFF"
                return error(label + " is not combinational")
        if looped
            return error(label + " has a combinational loop")
        if #inputs > 8
            return error("too many inputs {#inputs}")
        return void

    string evaluate(string vector, fault := "", stuck := "0")
        values := array(#signals, fill = "X")
        for: i < #inputs
            values[i] = if inputs[i] == fault then stuck else vector[i]
        for gate_id := topological[]
            gate := gates[gate_id]
            values[index(signals, gate.output)] = if gate.output == fault then stuck else gate_value(gate.kind, [for source := gate.inputs[] then values[index(signals, source)]])
        return [for output := outputs[] then values[index(signals, output)]].join("")

    string[] timing(bool period)
        latest := array(#signals, fill = -1)
        earliest := latest
        previous := latest
        endpoints := outputs
        flip_count := 0
        if period
            endpoints = []
        else
            for: i < #inputs
                latest[i] = 0
                earliest[i] = 0
        for gate := gates[]
            if gate.kind == "DFF"
                flip_count += 1
                if period
                    target := index(signals, gate.output)
                    latest[target] = gate.delay
                    earliest[target] = gate.delay
                    endpoints = endpoints.append(gate.inputs[1])
        for gate_id := topological[]
            gate := gates[gate_id]
            target := index(signals, gate.output)
            for source := gate.inputs[]
                origin := index(signals, source)
                if latest[origin] < 0
                    continue
                if latest[target] < latest[origin] + gate.delay
                    latest[target] = latest[origin] + gate.delay
                    previous[target] = origin
                if earliest[target] < 0 or earliest[target] > earliest[origin] + gate.delay
                    earliest[target] = earliest[origin] + gate.delay
        string[] lines := []
        best := -1
        for endpoint := endpoints[]
            target := index(signals, endpoint)
            if not period
                lines = lines.append(if latest[target] < 0 then endpoint + " unreachable" else "{endpoint} min {earliest[target]} max {latest[target]}")
            if latest[target] >= 0 and (best < 0 or latest[target] > latest[best])
                best = target
        prefix := if period then "flip-flops {flip_count} period" else "critical"
        if best < 0
            return lines.append(prefix + " none")
        string[] path := []
        current := best
        while current >= 0
            path = [signals[current]].concat(path)
            current = previous[current]
        return lines.append(prefix + " {latest[best]}: " + path.join(" -> "))

class Simulator()
    kinds := ["AND", "OR", "NAND", "NOR", "XOR", "XNOR", "NOT", "BUF", "MUX2", "DFF"]
    Module[] modules := []
    circuit := Circuit()
    built := false
    string[] values := []
    string[] watch := []
    Event[] queue := []
    Change[][] history := []
    timestamp := 0
    processed := 0
    halted := false
    error_line := 0

    int | error lookup(string label)
        for: i < #modules
            if modules[i].label == label
                return int(i)
        return error("unknown module " + label)

    void | error .define(string[] lines, int first_line)
        error_line = first_line
        header := lines[0].split(" ")
        if #header < 5 or header[2] != "IN" or header[-1] == "OUT"
            return error("bad module header")
        split := -1
        for: 3 <= i < #header
            if header[i] == "OUT"
                if split >= 0
                    return error("bad module header")
                split = int(i)
        if split < 0
            return error("bad module header")
        label := header[1]
        if not name_ok(label, true)
            return error("bad module name " + label)
        for existing := modules[]
            if existing.label == label
                return error("duplicate module " + label)
        inputs := header[3:<split]
        outputs := header[split + 1:]
        string[] ports := []
        for port := inputs.concat(outputs)[]
            if not name_ok(port)
                return error("bad name " + port)
            if has(ports, port)
                return error("duplicate port " + port)
            ports = ports.append(port)
        driven := inputs
        string[] used := []
        string[] reads := []
        int[] read_lines := []
        Gate[] gates := []
        Instance[] instances := []
        int[] order := []
        for: 1 <= row < #lines
            error_line = first_line + int(row)
            words := lines[row].split(" ")
            if has(kinds, words[0])
                if #words < 5 or words[-3] != "->"
                    return error("bad gate syntax")
                arrows := 0
                for word := words[]
                    if word == "->"
                        arrows += 1
                if arrows != 1
                    return error("bad gate syntax")
                gate_name := words[1]
                kind := words[0]
                sources := words[2:<#words - 3]
                output := words[-2]
                delay_word := words[-1]
                if not name_ok(gate_name)
                    return error("bad name " + gate_name)
                count := #sources
                nat low := if kind == "NOT" or kind == "BUF" then 1 elif kind == "MUX2" then 3 else 2
                high := if index(kinds, kind) < 6 then 8 else low
                if count < low or count > high
                    return error("bad input count {count} for {kind}")
                for signal := sources.append(output)[]
                    if not name_ok(signal)
                        return error("bad name " + signal)
                if not number_ok(delay_word)
                    return error("bad delay " + delay_word)
                delay := int(delay_word)
                if delay > 1000
                    return error("bad delay " + delay_word)
                if has(used, gate_name)
                    return error("duplicate name " + gate_name)
                if has(driven, output)
                    return error("multiple drivers for " + output)
                driven = driven.append(output)
                used = used.append(gate_name)
                order = order.append(int(#gates))
                gates = gates.append(Gate(gate_name, kind, sources, output, delay))
                for source := sources[]
                    reads = reads.append(source)
                    read_lines = read_lines.append(error_line)
            elif words[0] == "INST"
                if #words < 3
                    return error("bad instance syntax")
                instance_name := words[1]
                if not name_ok(instance_name)
                    return error("bad name " + instance_name)
                int module_id := try lookup(words[2])
                nested := modules[module_id]
                string[] connected_ports := []
                string[] connected_signals := []
                for connection := words[3:][]
                    pair := connection.split("=")
                    if #pair != 2 or pair[0] == "" or pair[1] == ""
                        return error("bad connection " + connection)
                    if not has(nested.inputs.concat(nested.outputs), pair[0])
                        return error("unknown port " + pair[0])
                    if has(connected_ports, pair[0])
                        return error("duplicate connection " + pair[0])
                    if not name_ok(pair[1])
                        return error("bad name " + pair[1])
                    connected_ports = connected_ports.append(pair[0])
                    connected_signals = connected_signals.append(pair[1])
                for port := nested.inputs[]
                    if not has(connected_ports, port)
                        return error("unconnected input " + port)
                if has(used, instance_name)
                    return error("duplicate name " + instance_name)
                for: i < #connected_ports
                    signal := connected_signals[i]
                    if has(nested.outputs, connected_ports[i])
                        if has(driven, signal)
                            return error("multiple drivers for " + signal)
                        driven = driven.append(signal)
                    else
                        reads = reads.append(signal)
                        read_lines = read_lines.append(error_line)
                used = used.append(instance_name)
                order = order.append(-1 - int(#instances))
                instances = instances.append(Instance(instance_name, module_id, connected_ports, connected_signals))
            else
                return error("unknown statement " + words[0])
        for output := outputs[]
            reads = reads.append(output)
            read_lines = read_lines.append(first_line)
        for: i < #reads
            if not has(driven, reads[i])
                error_line = read_lines[i]
                return error("undriven signal " + reads[i])
        modules = modules.append(Module(label, inputs, outputs, gates, instances, order))
        emit("defined {label} inputs {#inputs} outputs {#outputs} gates {#gates} instances {#instances}")
        return void

    string actual(string signal, string prefix, string[] ports, string[] destinations)
        found := index(ports, signal)
        return if found >= 0 then destinations[found] else prefix + signal

    Gate[] expand(int module_id, string prefix, string[] ports, string[] destinations)
        definition := modules[module_id]
        Gate[] result := []
        for item := definition.order[]
            if item >= 0
                gate := definition.gates[item]
                string[] sources := [for signal := gate.inputs[] then actual(signal, prefix, ports, destinations)]
                result = result.append(Gate(prefix + gate.label, gate.kind, sources, actual(gate.output, prefix, ports, destinations), gate.delay))
            else
                nested := definition.instances[-1 - item]
                string[] mapping := [for signal := nested.signals[] then actual(signal, prefix, ports, destinations)]
                result = result.concat(expand(nested.module_id, prefix + nested.label + ".", nested.ports, mapping))
        return result

    Circuit flatten(int module_id)
        definition := modules[module_id]
        result := Circuit(definition.label, definition.inputs, definition.outputs, expand(module_id, "", [], []))
        .result.initialize()
        return result

    void hierarchy(int module_id, nat depth)
        for nested := modules[module_id].instances[]
            emit(" " * (depth * 2) + nested.label + " " + modules[nested.module_id].label)
            hierarchy(nested.module_id, depth + 1)

    void .reset()
        values = array(#circuit.signals, fill = "X")
        Change[] empty := []
        history = array(#circuit.signals, fill = empty)
        queue = []
        timestamp = 0
        processed = 0
        halted = false

    void .schedule(int when, int signal_id, string value)
        insertion := #queue
        while insertion > 0 and queue[insertion - 1].timestamp > when
            insertion -= 1
        queue = queue[:<insertion].append(Event(when, signal_id, value)).concat(queue[insertion:])

    void .run(int end)
        event_count := 0
        glitches := 0
        while #queue > 0 and queue[0].timestamp < end
            when := queue[0].timestamp
            original := values
            changed := array(#values, fill = false)
            step_count := 0
            while #queue > 0 and queue[0].timestamp == when
                if step_count == 1000
                    queue = []
                    timestamp = when
                    halted = true
                    emit("halted: oscillation at time {when}")
                    return
                event := queue[0]
                queue = queue[1:]
                step_count += 1
                processed += 1
                event_count += 1
                before := values[event.signal_id]
                if before == event.value
                    continue
                values[event.signal_id] = event.value
                changed[event.signal_id] = true
                string signal := circuit.signals[event.signal_id]
                for gate_id := circuit.readers(signal)[]
                    Gate gate := circuit.gates[gate_id]
                    if gate.kind != "DFF"
                        output := gate_value(gate.kind, [for source := gate.inputs[] then values[index(circuit.signals, source)]])
                        .schedule(when + gate.delay, index(circuit.signals, gate.output), output)
                    elif signal == gate.inputs[0] and before == "0" and event.value == "1"
                        .schedule(when + gate.delay, index(circuit.signals, gate.output), values[index(circuit.signals, gate.inputs[1])])
            for: i < #values
                if values[i] != original[i]
                    history[i] = history[i].append(Change(when, values[i]))
                elif changed[i]
                    glitches += 1
            for signal := watch[]
                signal_id := index(circuit.signals, signal)
                if values[signal_id] != original[signal_id]
                    emit("{when} {signal} {values[signal_id]}")
        timestamp = end
        emit("run {end} events {event_count} glitches {glitches} pending {#queue}")

    int | error require_signal(string signal, input_only := false)
        result := index(if input_only then circuit.inputs else circuit.signals, signal)
        if result < 0
            return error((if input_only then "not an input " else "unknown signal ") + signal)
        return result

    int | error parse_time(string word)
        result := try number(word)
        if result < timestamp
            return error("time {result} is in the past")
        return result

    string[] describe(string[] signals)
        return [for signal := signals[] then signal + "=" + values[index(circuit.signals, signal)]]

    void | error .execute(string[] words)
        commands := ["BUILD", "RESET", "SET", "APPLY", "PULSE", "CLOCK", "RUN", "WATCH", "UNWATCH", "SHOW", "CHECK", "PROBE", "WAVE", "HISTORY", "ACTIVITY", "STATUS", "MODULES", "NETLIST", "HIERARCHY", "STATS", "TRUTHTABLE", "EQUIV", "FAULTS", "CRITICAL", "PERIOD"]
        counts := [1, 0, 3, 2, 3, 4, 1, 1, 1, 0, 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1]
        command := words[0]
        args := words[1:]
        command_id := index(commands, command)
        if command_id < 0
            return error("unknown command " + command)
        if int(#args) < counts[command_id] or (not has(["WATCH", "UNWATCH", "SHOW"], command) and int(#args) != counts[command_id])
            return error("wrong argument count")
        if command_id >= 1 and command_id <= 15 and not built
            return error("no circuit")
        if command_id >= 2 and command_id <= 6 and halted
            return error("simulation halted")
        if command == "MODULES"
            emit("modules {#modules}")
            for: i < #modules
                Circuit flat := flatten(int(i))
                emit("{flat.label} inputs {#flat.inputs} outputs {#flat.outputs} gates {#flat.gates}")
            return
        if command == "BUILD" or command_id >= 17
            int module_id := try lookup(args[0])
            Circuit flat := flatten(module_id)
            if command == "BUILD"
                circuit = flat
                built = true
                watch = []
                .reset()
                emit("built {flat.label} signals {#flat.signals} gates {#flat.gates}")
            elif command == "HIERARCHY"
                emit(flat.label)
                hierarchy(module_id, 1)
            elif command == "NETLIST"
                emit("netlist {flat.label} gates {#flat.gates} signals {#flat.signals}")
                for gate := flat.gates[]
                    emit(gate.label + " " + gate.kind + " " + gate.inputs.join(" ") + " -> {gate.output} {gate.delay}")
            elif command == "STATS"
                levels := array(#flat.signals, fill = 0)
                depth := 0
                for gate_id := flat.topological[]
                    gate := flat.gates[gate_id]
                    level := 0
                    for source := gate.inputs[]
                        if levels[index(flat.signals, source)] > level
                            level = levels[index(flat.signals, source)]
                    levels[index(flat.signals, gate.output)] = level + 1
                    if level + 1 > depth
                        depth = level + 1
                depth_word := if flat.looped then "-" else string(depth)
                emit("stats {flat.label} gates {#flat.gates} signals {#flat.signals} depth {depth_word}")
                type_words := ["types"]
                for kind := kinds[]
                    count := 0
                    for gate := flat.gates[]
                        if gate.kind == kind
                            count += 1
                    if count > 0
                        type_words = type_words.append(kind).append(string(count))
                emit(type_words.join(" "))
                best := flat.signals[0]
                for signal := flat.signals[]
                    if #flat.readers(signal) > #flat.readers(best)
                        best = signal
                emit("max fanout {best} {#flat.readers(best)}")
            elif command == "CRITICAL" or command == "PERIOD"
                has_flip := false
                for gate := flat.gates[]
                    if gate.kind == "DFF"
                        has_flip = true
                if command == "PERIOD" and not has_flip
                    return error(flat.label + " has no flip-flops")
                if flat.looped
                    return error(flat.label + " has a combinational loop")
                for line := flat.timing(command == "PERIOD")[]
                    emit(line)
            else
                other := Circuit()
                if command == "EQUIV"
                    int other_id := try lookup(args[1])
                    other = flatten(other_id)
                try flat.combinational()
                if command == "EQUIV"
                    try other.combinational()
                    if #flat.inputs != #other.inputs or #flat.outputs != #other.outputs
                        return error("port mismatch")
                row_count := 1
                for: i < #flat.inputs
                    row_count *= 2
                vectors := [for row := (0:<int(row_count))[] then bits(row, #flat.inputs)]
                if command == "TRUTHTABLE"
                    emit(flat.inputs.append("|").concat(flat.outputs).join(" "))
                    for vector := vectors[]
                        output := flat.evaluate(vector)
                        emit([for i := (nat(0):<#vector)[] then vector[i]].append("|").concat([for i := (nat(0):<#output)[] then output[i]]).join(" "))
                elif command == "EQUIV"
                    for vector := vectors[]
                        first := flat.evaluate(vector)
                        second := other.evaluate(vector)
                        if first != second
                            emit("not equivalent at {vector}: {first} vs {second}")
                            return
                    emit("equivalent")
                else
                    string[] undetected := []
                    tests := array(#vectors, fill = false)
                    for signal := flat.signals[]
                        for stuck := ["0", "1"][]
                            detected := false
                            for: row < #vectors
                                if flat.evaluate(vectors[row], signal, stuck) != flat.evaluate(vectors[row])
                                    tests[row] = true
                                    detected = true
                                    break
                            if not detected
                                undetected = undetected.append(signal + "/" + stuck)
                    total := 2 * #flat.signals
                    emit("faults {total} detected {total - #undetected}")
                    for fault := undetected[]
                        emit("undetected " + fault)
                    emit(["tests"].concat([for row := (nat(0):<#vectors)[] if tests[row] then vectors[row]]).join(" "))
            return
        if command == "RESET"
            .reset()
            emit("reset")
        elif command == "SET"
            int when := try parse_time(args[0])
            int signal_id := try require_signal(args[1], true)
            value := try value_word(args[2])
            .schedule(when, signal_id, value)
            emit("set {args[1]} {value} at {when}")
        elif command == "APPLY"
            int when := try parse_time(args[0])
            vector := args[1]
            valid := #vector == #circuit.inputs
            for: i < #vector
                if not "01X".contains(vector[i])
                    valid = false
            if not valid
                return error("bad vector " + vector)
            for: i < #vector
                .schedule(when, int(i), vector[i])
            emit("apply {vector} at {when}")
        elif command == "PULSE" or command == "CLOCK"
            int signal_id := try require_signal(args[0], true)
            int when := try parse_time(args[1])
            width := try number(args[2], true)
            if command == "PULSE"
                .schedule(when, signal_id, "1")
                .schedule(when + width, signal_id, "0")
                emit("pulse {args[0]} {when} {when + width}")
            else
                count := try number(args[3], true)
                for: i < count
                    .schedule(when + i * width, signal_id, string(i % 2))
                emit("clock {args[0]} events {count} last {when + (count - 1) * width}")
        elif command == "RUN"
            end := try number(args[0])
            if end <= timestamp
                return error("time {end} is not after {timestamp}")
            .run(end)
        elif command == "WATCH" or command == "UNWATCH"
            string[] seen := []
            for signal := args[]
                int checked := try require_signal(signal)
                if has(seen, signal) or (has(watch, signal) == (command == "WATCH"))
                    return error((if command == "WATCH" then "already watched " else "not watched ") + signal)
                seen = seen.append(signal)
            watch = if command == "WATCH" then watch.concat(args) else [for signal := watch[] if not has(args, signal) then signal]
            emit("watching " + (if #watch == 0 then "nothing" else watch.join(" ")))
        elif command == "SHOW"
            for signal := args[]
                int checked := try require_signal(signal)
            emit((if #args > 0 then describe(args) else describe(circuit.inputs).append("|").concat(describe(circuit.outputs))).join(" "))
        elif command == "CHECK" or command == "HISTORY" or command == "PROBE"
            signal := args[0]
            int signal_id := try require_signal(signal)
            if command == "CHECK"
                expected := try value_word(args[1])
                emit("check {signal}={expected} " + (if values[signal_id] == expected then "ok" else "failed ({values[signal_id]})"))
            elif command == "HISTORY"
                records := ["history {signal} changes {#history[signal_id]}"]
                for change := history[signal_id][]
                    records = records.append("{change.timestamp}:{change.value}")
                emit(records.join(" "))
            else
                prefix := "{signal}={values[signal_id]} driven by "
                if has(circuit.inputs, signal)
                    emit(prefix + "input")
                else
                    for gate := circuit.gates[]
                        if gate.output == signal
                            emit(prefix + gate.label + " " + gate.kind + " " + describe(gate.inputs).join(" ") + " delay {gate.delay}")
                int[] readers := circuit.readers(signal)
                emit(["fanout {#readers}"].concat([for gate_id := readers[] then circuit.gates[gate_id].label]).join(" "))
        elif command == "WAVE"
            start := try number(args[0])
            end := try number(args[1])
            if not (start < end and end <= timestamp)
                return error("bad range {start} {end}")
            if #watch == 0
                return error("nothing watched")
            for signal := watch[]
                changes := history[index(circuit.signals, signal)]
                nat cursor := 0
                value := "X"
                wave := ""
                for: start <= when < end
                    while cursor < #changes and changes[cursor].timestamp <= when
                        value = changes[cursor].value
                        cursor += 1
                    wave += value
                emit(signal + " " + wave)
        elif command == "ACTIVITY"
            count := try number(args[0], true)
            string[] ranked := circuit.signals.sorted()
            for: i < #ranked
                best := i
                for: i + 1 <= j < #ranked
                    if #history[index(circuit.signals, ranked[j])] > #history[index(circuit.signals, ranked[best])] or (#history[index(circuit.signals, ranked[j])] == #history[index(circuit.signals, ranked[best])] and compare_text(ranked[j], ranked[best]) < 0)
                        best = j
                saved := ranked[i]
                ranked[i] = ranked[best]
                ranked[best] = saved
            for: i < #ranked
                if int(i) >= count
                    break
                emit("{ranked[i]} {#history[index(circuit.signals, ranked[i])]}")
        else
            halted_word := if halted then "yes" else "no"
            emit("circuit {circuit.label} time {timestamp} pending {#queue} events {processed} halted {halted_word}")
            string[] totals := []
            for value := ["0", "1", "X"][]
                count := 0
                for actual_value := values[]
                    if actual_value == value
                        count += 1
                totals = totals.append("{value}:{count}")
            emit("values " + totals.join(" "))
        return void

void run_commands()
    simulator := Simulator()
    line_number := 0
    while true
        line := ""
        scan(&line)
        line_number += 1
        if line == "END"
            break
        words := line.split(" ")
        if words[0] == "MODULE"
            first_line := line_number
            lines := [line]
            while true
                scan(&line)
                line_number += 1
                if line == "ENDMODULE"
                    break
                lines = lines.append(line)
            match .simulator.define(lines, first_line)
                void
                    void
                error failure
                    emit("error: line {simulator.error_line}: " + failure.message)
        else
            match .simulator.execute(words)
                void
                    void
                error failure
                    emit("error: line {line_number}: " + failure.message)

run_commands()
